meta.title: AI sales agents: follow up every lead before it goes cold | TenthMatrix
meta.description: AI sales agents that reply to enquiries in minutes, qualify buyers, research accounts and keep your CRM up to date. A person approves every email.

header.title: Follow up every lead before it goes cold
header.subtitle: An AI sales agent replies to enquiries in minutes, finds out what the buyer needs and keeps your CRM up to date. Your team spends its time with people who are ready to buy.

sales.pain: Leads go cold before anyone follows up

problem.title: Sound familiar?
items: Enquiries wait hours or days for a reply, and buyers go elsewhere.
Salespeople spend their mornings updating the CRM instead of selling.
Nobody has time to look into a company before the call.
Follow-ups slip whenever the team is busy.

items.title: Replies within minutes
items.description: Answers every new enquiry, day or night, and asks the questions a good salesperson would ask.

items.title: Finds the serious buyers
items.description: Checks budget, timing and need against your rules, and passes the good leads to a person.

items.title: Prepares your team
items.description: Looks up the company before the call and writes a short brief.

items.title: Drafts the follow-up
items.description: Writes the follow-up email and the CRM update. Your salesperson checks it and presses send.

example.title: An example morning
example.intro: Example scenario. Times and steps are illustrative.

steps.title: 9:12 · A buyer fills in your website form
steps.description: The agent replies within minutes, asks about budget and timing, and offers a call slot.

steps.title: 9:30 · The lead is qualified
steps.description: The agent scores the lead against your rules and writes a two-line summary in the CRM.

steps.title: 10:00 · Your salesperson gets a brief
steps.description: Who the buyer is, what they asked and what they need, ready before the call.

steps.title: After the call · Follow-up drafted
steps.description: The agent drafts the email and the CRM note. A person approves it before it is sent.

technical: Connects to your CRM, email and calendar (through connectors, often called MCP)
Model of your choice: Claude, OpenAI, Gemini or an open-weight model you host yourself
Runs in your cloud, on your own machines, or managed by us
A full record of every action the agent takes, with cost and timing
Passwords and keys kept in a separate secrets store (WSL Vault), never in the agent

items.title: Drafts in your voice

items.title: Turns one piece into many

items.title: Publishes after approval

items.title: Reports on what worked

steps.title: Monday · You send a two-line brief

steps.title: Monday afternoon · Drafts arrive

steps.title: Friday · The report

meta.title: Back-office AI agents: invoices, orders and admin done for you | TenthMatrix
meta.description: Agents that read invoices, orders and forms, enter them into your finance system, flag what doesn't match and stop for approval before anything is sent or paid.

header.title: Take the busywork out of invoices, orders and admin
header.subtitle: Back-office agents read invoices, orders and emails, enter them into your systems and flag what doesn't match. Nothing is sent, paid or deleted without a person's approval.

back-office.pain: Hours lost to invoices and order entry

problem.title: Sound familiar?
items: Hours every week spent typing invoices and orders into the finance system.
Month-end takes days, and most of it is copying and checking.
A shared inbox full of requests that all follow the same few patterns.
Reports are rebuilt by hand from the same spreadsheets every month.

items.title: Reads the paperwork
items.description: Invoices, orders, delivery notes and forms, from email or upload.

items.title: Enters and matches
items.description: Keys the data into your finance or order system and matches invoices to orders.

items.title: Flags the exceptions
items.description: Anything that doesn't match goes to a person, with the reason.

items.title: Waits for approval
items.description: No payment, posting or deletion happens without a named approver.

steps.title: An invoice arrives by email
steps.description: The agent reads it and pulls out the supplier, lines, totals and VAT.

steps.title: It is matched to the order
steps.description: Prices and quantities are checked against the purchase order.

steps.title: One line doesn't match
steps.description: The agent flags it to your finance team with the difference highlighted.

steps.title: A person approves
steps.description: Once approved, the agent posts it. Everything it did is recorded.

technical: Document reading (extraction) with checks against your own rules
Connects to finance, ERP and order systems through their APIs or exports
Approval gates on anything that sends, spends or deletes
Model of your choice: Claude, OpenAI, Gemini or an open-weight model you host yourself
Runs in your cloud, on your own machines, or managed by us
A full record of every action the agent takes, with cost and timing
Passwords and keys kept in a separate secrets store (WSL Vault), never in the agent

meta.title: AI customer support agents: answer customers faster | TenthMatrix
meta.description: Support agents that answer common questions from your own documents, draft replies for your team and send urgent tickets to the right person.

header.title: Answer customers faster, with your team in charge
header.subtitle: A support agent answers common questions from your own documents and drafts replies for the harder ones. Your team checks what matters and handles the rest.

problem.title: Sound familiar?
items: The support inbox never gets to zero.
Your team answers the same ten questions by hand every day.
Customers who write in the evening wait until the morning.
Urgent problems sit in the queue behind routine ones.

items.title: Answers from your documents
items.description: Looks up your help pages, policies and past answers before it replies.

items.title: Drafts the harder replies
items.description: For anything unusual, it writes a draft for a person to check.

items.title: Sorts the urgent ones
items.description: Spots complaints, outages and VIP customers and sends them straight to a person.

items.title: Spots the gaps
items.description: When the same question keeps coming up, it suggests a new help page.

steps.title: 8:40pm · A customer asks about delivery
steps.description: The agent checks the order and your delivery policy and replies straight away.

steps.title: 9:15pm · A refund request comes in
steps.description: The agent drafts a reply and leaves it for your team, because refunds need a person.

steps.title: 9:30pm · A complaint arrives
steps.description: It is marked urgent and sent to the duty manager.

steps.title: Next morning · Your team starts ahead
steps.description: Routine questions are done; the drafts and the urgent case are waiting.

technical: Answers grounded in your own documents (retrieval, often called RAG)

Rules for what the agent may answer alone and what always goes to a person

meta.title: Platforms, DevOps and security: modern systems that stay up | TenthMatrix
meta.description: Platform modernisation, automated releases, security testing and 24/7 monitoring, so your systems stay up and changes go live safely.

header.title: Modern, secure systems that stay up
header.subtitle: We modernise old systems without a risky big switch-over, test every update before it goes live, and watch your systems around the clock.

platforms-devops.pain: Releases are risky and outages come as a surprise

problem.title: Sound familiar?
items: Every release is nerve-racking, so releases happen rarely.
An old system runs the business and nobody wants to touch it.
Customers notice outages before you do.
You are not sure how exposed you are to an attack.

items.title: Modernise step by step
items.description: Move old systems to modern ones a piece at a time, with no big-bang switch-over.

items.title: Release safely
items.description: Updates are tested in stages and only go live when they pass. Failures roll back on their own.

items.title: Protect the front door
items.description: Security testing, attack and overload protection, and monitoring for threats.

items.title: Watch it 24/7
items.description: Uptime, certificate and DNS checks, with alerts before customers notice.

steps.title: A developer finishes a change
steps.description: Automated tests run straight away.

steps.title: It is tried in stages
steps.description: Integration, test and acceptance environments, each with health checks.

steps.title: It goes live
steps.description: Only when every check passes. If something fails, it rolls back on its own.

steps.title: It is watched
steps.description: Monitoring confirms the change is healthy, and alerts a person if not.

technical: CI/CD with int, test, acc and prod environments (Ring Promoter)
API gateway, web application firewall (WAF), rate limits and CDN (Proxy10x)
Kubernetes, GitOps and infrastructure as code
Penetration testing, SIEM and SOC monitoring
Secrets and keys in WSL Vault, with an audit log
